inference_status: No valid group-level uncertainty interval, significance test or causal effect estimate can be obtained from one pre-existing class per condition. Student-level change-score tests treat classmates as independent treatment replications and confound instructional condition with class identity.

student_level_welch_illustration_only.interpretation: Algebraic Welch statistic calculated from 48 student-level change values for demonstration only. This is not a valid inferential test for the class-level instructional contrast; do not use its p-value or confidence interval as evidence of a routine effect.

change_score_rule: change_score = displayed post_score minus displayed pre_score, rounded to one decimal. All 48 calculated values reconcile with the displayed scores.
interpretation_boundary: Synthetic results only. One pre-existing class received each routine, so differences may reflect existing class composition, teacher or classroom conditions. The two class change means are descriptive; no valid between-class treatment test or causal effect follows.
